title: M278 cross-arm consistency as a weak verifier: sentiment -> NLI check -> escalate on contradiction
question: Does the NLI arm re-checking the sentiment arm's label as entailment/contradiction buy anything, measured against the generalist-only reading on the same rows?

loop.protocol: specialist labels -> NLI checks 'this review is {label}' as hypothesis vs the review as premise -> contradiction escalates to the generalist's label; entailment/neutral keep the specialist's label
loop.honesty: the weak-verifier gain is reported even if ~0 (the measured M263 lesson: weak instruments must be tested, not trusted)

mix.reuse_note: declared re-use (one held-out read per configuration)

grading.sentiment: last occurrence of positive/negative in the lowercased answer (the sealed grader)
